exposure: Cervical ripening with a Foley catheter
Cervical ripening using a controlled-release dinoprostone vaginal insert
Cervical ripening using dinoprostone vaginal gel
cohort: 229 multiparous women with a singleton gestation who required cervical ripening at a single tertiary center from 2014 to 2019
finding: In multiparous women requiring cervical ripening, all methods have similar success rates, but using a controlled-release dinoprostone vaginal insert is associated with a considerably longer interval to delivery compared to a Foley catheter or dinoprostone vaginal gel.
